title: 第十七章 猛第十八章 继续猛
lines: 第十七章：猛
楚静瑶以前看过极品飞车的电影，事后她总觉得电影里的车技都是经过后期特效加工出来的，世界上怎么可能会有那么炫丽、疯狂的车技。
今天，她算是亲身见识到了。
老捷达喷着浓烟，在早晨八点钟的马路上横冲飞驰，早晨八点钟的马路依旧是上班早高峰，但狭小拥挤的缝隙，丝毫遏制不住它的疯狂。
楚静瑶紧紧的握着车扶手，心脏砰砰的跳乱起来，眼神里满是惊慌之色，但同时心里却也隐隐的感觉到一阵刺激，就好像是在坐过山车……
老捷达疯狂的咆哮，顿时将整条死气沉沉且幽怨压抑的早高峰马路搅和的沸沸扬扬，惹来了一片片惊讶的目光，和一阵阵惊声的尖叫——哇！
尾随的黑色吉普车和面包车也跟着加快了速度，但跟‘身姿轻盈飘逸’的老捷达根本不是一个档次的，它们跌跌撞撞、笨拙不堪，时不时的还剐蹭到别的私家车，顿时惹来了一片怨声载道的怒骂和报警声。
楚静瑶一边心跳尤如鹿撞，一边忍不住的侧目看向林昆，真不敢想象这个流氓以前是干什么的，即便是在部队里服役过，开车也不应该这么霸道吧。
她哪里想象的到，坐在她身旁的这个流氓，过去曾一边叼着雪茄吐烟圈，一边开着野马吉普车在恐怖分子的枪林弹雨种冲锋陷阵、来去自如。
吱嘎一声急刹车，老捷达停在了楚静瑶上班的写字楼下。车子刚一停下，楚静瑶马上就推开车门，哇哇的吐了起来，随后掏出一张纸巾擦擦嘴，回过头来恨恨的瞪了林昆一眼，拎起香包转身向写字楼大门走去。
林昆咧嘴笑笑……
几乎楚静瑶前脚刚走进写字楼，后脚黑色的吉普车和面包车就追了过来，林昆透过后视镜看了看，嘴角轻描淡写的一笑，把手伸出窗外冲后头竖了一下中指，旋即脚下的油门一踩，老捷达咆哮一声又冲了出去。
楚静瑶闻声回过头，正好看到了黑色吉普车和面包车紧追着老捷达而去，恍然间，她的心里似乎明白了什么，一阵说不出的感觉浮上心头。
楚静瑶站在门口稍稍愣了一下，小声的自言自语：“算了，我才不管呢，让他自生自灭去吧！”拎着香包，踩着高跟鞋哒哒的向电梯走去。
林昆不知道身后的那辆吉普车面包车到底什么来头，他刚才开着车一路狂奔，是为了送楚静瑶上班不迟到，现在开车狂奔则完全是玩心大起。
他是起了玩心，可老捷达毕竟闲置的年头久了，哪能经得起这么折腾，狂奔到沿海大道上的时候，发动机‘嗡’的一声悲鸣，就地抛锚了。
“我去！”
林昆恨铁不成钢的在方向盘上拍了一把，看了一眼后视镜，后面的黑色吉普车和面包车快速的靠近，他嘴角邪意的一笑，掏出了个根烟叼上。
吉普车停在了老捷达的车前，面包车停在了老捷达的旁边，两辆车的车门打开，一连串的下来了十多个人，但看这十多个人全都是一身戾气，脸上带着煞气，一看就是道上混的。
为首的是一个平头，一米八左右的身高，身形魁梧相貌逼人，这人不是别人，正是疯彪手下的四大金刚之一，疯彪贴身的得力干将阿狗。
林昆风云不惊的坐在车里抽烟，一只胳膊搭在车窗框上，另一只手捏着烟卷，浑然把阿狗和他的手下当成空气处理。
阿狗阴沉着脸走过来，冷哼一声，道：“小子，你倒是特么的再跑啊！”
林昆斜的瞥了阿狗一眼，轻佻的一笑，道：“哥们儿，你瞎啊，没看到我车坏了啊。”
阿狗冷笑一声，不动声色，站在他两边的小弟却是怒了，他们的狗哥岂是随便被人辱骂的，当即就吵着嚷着要揍林昆，被阿狗给拦下了。
“小子，你特么的找死，谁都敢骂！”
“信不信老子弄残你！”
“麻痹的！”
一群小弟嚷嚷着。
林昆根本不放在心上，嘴角一直挂着一抹轻佻的笑意，深吸一口气，吐出个大烟圈，淡淡的冲阿狗问道：“哥们儿，你追我这么远，目的？”
阿狗冷笑着道：“你的车坏了，我们的车没坏，走吧，有人想见你。”

Chapter 17: Fierce
Chu Jingyao had watched the movie Need for Speed before. Afterwards, she always felt that the car skills in the movie were all processed by post-production special effects. How could there be such dazzling and crazy car skills in the world.
Today, she saw it for herself.
The old Jetta was puffing out thick smoke and speeding across the road at eight o'clock in the morning. The road at eight o'clock in the morning was still the morning rush hour, but the narrow and crowded gap could not contain its madness at all.
Chu Jingyao held the armrest of the car tightly, her heart was beating wildly, her eyes were full of panic, but at the same time, she felt a faint excitement in her heart, as if she was riding a roller coaster...
The crazy roar of the old Jetta immediately stirred up the entire lifeless and resentful morning rush hour road into an uproar, attracting surprised looks and bursts of screams - Wow!
The black jeeps and vans following also accelerated, but they were not at the same level as the "lithe and elegant" old Jetta. They stumbled, clumsy, and occasionally hit other private cars, which immediately caused a lot of resentment, curses, and alarms.
Chu Jingyao's heart beat like a deer, and she couldn't help but glance sideways at Lin Kun. She really couldn't imagine what this gangster had done before. Even if he had served in the army, he shouldn't be so domineering when driving.
She could never have imagined that the gangster sitting next to her used to puff out smoke rings from a cigar while driving a Mustang Jeep and charge into battles amid hail of bullets and bullets from terrorists, coming and going freely.
With a screech of brakes, the old Jetta stopped under the office building where Chu Jingyao worked. As soon as the car stopped, Chu Jingyao immediately opened the door and vomited. Then she took out a tissue and wiped her mouth. She turned around and glared at Lin Kun bitterly. She picked up the sachet and turned towards the door of the office building.
Lin Kun grinned...
Almost as soon as Chu Jingyao walked into the office building, a black jeep and a van were chasing after her. Lin Kun looked through the rearview mirror, smiled lightly, stretched his hand out the window and raised his middle finger behind his head. Immediately, he stepped on the accelerator, and the old Jetta roared out again.
Chu Jingyao turned around when she heard the sound, and saw the black jeep and van chasing the old Jetta. Suddenly, she seemed to understand something in her heart, and an indescribable feeling came to her mind.
Chu Jingyao stood at the door and was stunned for a moment, then whispered to herself: "Forget it, I don't care, let him fend for himself!" Carrying the sachet, she walked towards the elevator on high heels.
Lin Kun didn't know the origin of the jeep and van behind him. He drove all the way just now to take Chu Jingyao to work so that she wouldn't be late, but now he was driving just for fun.
He was having fun, but after all, the old Jetta had been idle for a long time. How could it withstand such a torment? When he rushed to the coastal road, the engine made a mournful "hum" and broke down on the spot.
"I'll go!"
Lin Kun slapped the steering wheel in despair, glanced at the rearview mirror, and saw the black jeep and van approaching quickly from behind. He smiled evilly at the corner of his mouth, took out a cigarette and held it in his mouth.
The jeep parked in front of the old Jetta, and the van parked next to the old Jetta. The doors of the two cars opened, and more than ten people got out one after another. However, these more than ten people all looked angry and had evil looks on their faces. It looked like they were gangsters on the road.
The leader is a man with a flat head, about 1.8 meters tall, and a burly figure with an attractive appearance. This person is none other than Agou, one of the Four King Kongs under Crazy Biao, and his right-hand man.
Lin Kun sat in the car calmly and smoked, one arm resting on the window frame and the other hand holding a cigarette, completely treating Agou and his men like nothing.
Agou came over with a sullen face, snorted coldly, and said, "Boy, you're so damn good at running away again!"
Lin Kun glanced at Agou sideways, smiled frivolously, and said: "Brother, you are blind, you didn't see that my car broke down."
"Heh..."
Agou sneered and remained calm, but the younger brothers standing on both sides of him were angry. How could their dog brother be insulted casually? He immediately started shouting about beating Lin Kun, but Agou stopped him.
"Boy, you're looking for death, no one dares to scold you!"
"Believe it or not, I will cripple you!"
"Paralyzed!"
…
A group of younger brothers shouted.
Lin Kun didn't take it to heart at all. He kept a frivolous smile on his lips. He took a deep breath, blew out a big smoke ring, and asked Agou calmly: "Brother, why are you chasing me so far?"
Agou sneered and said: "Your car is broken down, our car is not broken down, let's go, someone wants to see you."
title_en: Chapter 17: Fierce Chapter 18: Continue to be fierce
